about_the_game:
“Resources Assemble!” — working title, subject to change before release

The game is in early development, and visuals and interface are still being refined

Resources Assemble!

Deep factory engineering combined with the comfort of idle mechanics.

Build and optimize production — from the first mines to launching rockets. Your factory keeps running even offline, while you manage its growth, scaling, and automation.

Add to your Wishlist to not miss the demo and release!

Want to follow news and beta tests? Join our Discord server!

Key Features

  • Complex production chains and smart logistics

  • Balance of energy, speed, and productivity

  • Idle progress: production continues without your involvement

  • Technology tree, new recipes, and machines

  • Endless scaling and flexible optimization

In Development

  • Game Data Editor — create your own resources, machines, and recipes

  • Import support from compatible sources — read data from other factory games, including *Factorio*-compatible formats

  • Defense — respond to threats that emerge as your factory grows

  • Space stage — expand production beyond the planet

  • Expanded technology tree and new resource types

  • Transport and logistics between factories and planets

Mine — Process — Build Machines — Research — Expand

From Earth to Space

The ultimate goal is to create a system capable of building and launching a rocket. Along the way, you’ll unlock new opportunities and refine your industrial ecosystem.

Resources Assemble! — a game for those who enjoy turning chaos into perfect order. Become the architect of a fully automated factory!
